configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Ninja, a build tree named after the preset, and a compilation database for the language server, for the default Ampere-through-Blackwell architectures. Pin the compiler path or UFORM_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES of one machine in a CMakeUserPresets.json on top.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimized host code with full DWARF, every library, tool and suite.

configurePresets.name: check
configurePresets.description: Does it still compile, nothing more: -O0 without debug information on the host and in ptxas, with warnings as errors.

configurePresets.name: relwithdebinfo
configurePresets.displayName: RelWithDebInfo - optimized with symbols and device line tables
configurePresets.description: Optimized, with host DWARF and -lineinfo device line tables for cuda-gdb and Nsight. The tree `.clangd` reads.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Libraries, the trainer and the conformance suites, fully optimized.

configurePresets.name: library
configurePresets.displayName: Library - the C library for the host alone
configurePresets.description: The C library alone, fully optimized, without the trainer or the conformance suites.

configurePresets.name: stub_library
configurePresets.displayName: Stub Library - the C headers over a library that reports every verb unsupported

configurePresets.name: swift
configurePresets.displayName: Swift - the XCFramework or artifact bundle SwiftPM links
configurePresets.description: The CPU library packed for SwiftPM, or with UFORM_BUILD_STUB the stand-in the Swift suite runs against. An Apple slice names its SDK and architecture, here or with -D, and any other target its Swift triples in UFORM_SWIFT_TRIPLES.

configurePresets.name: cuda_rocm_library
configurePresets.displayName: CUDA and ROCm Library - the C library with both GPU residencies
configurePresets.description: Clang compiles the host code of both vendors: NVCC hosts on it, and ROCm's own Clang compiles the HIP units.

configurePresets.name: wasm32_emscripten
configurePresets.displayName: WebAssembly Emscripten - the C library for browsers and Node

configurePresets.name: wasm32_wasi
configurePresets.displayName: WebAssembly WASI - the C library for standalone runtimes
